title: DeLonge's NRO sources on predicting episodic craft visits
summary: UAPGerb tells of DeLonge's NRO sources on predicting episodic craft visits, about October 2017 at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he says that his highlevel sources in the NRO specifically told him that scientists and eggghheads had figured out ways to basically pre-predict when and where craft would appear
